question: How many seats did the BJP win in the February 2025 Delhi Assembly elections?
solution:
The correct answer is __**48**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) won **48 seats** in the February 2025 Delhi Assembly elections.
 
• This was a significant increase compared to their previous performance in the 2020 Delhi elections.
 
• The BJP focused on issues such as development, law and order, and governance during their campaign.
 
• The election marked a notable shift in the political landscape of Delhi, with BJP gaining ground against the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP).
 
• The BJP's performance was attributed to its strong grassroots mobilization and campaigning efforts led by senior party leaders.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Delhi Assembly:**

 
 
• The Delhi Legislative Assembly has a total of **70 seats**.
 
• The party or coalition securing a majority (36 seats or more) forms the government in Delhi.
 
 
 
• **Role of BJP:**
 
 
• The BJP is one of the two major political parties in India, alongside the Indian National Congress (INC).
 
• It has a strong presence across India and has been the ruling party at the national level since 2014.
 
 
 
• **Key Electoral Issues:**
 
 
• In the 2025 Delhi Assembly elections, major issues included unemployment, women’s safety, pollution, and infrastructure development.
 
• BJP highlighted its national-level schemes like Swachh Bharat Mission and Ayushman Bharat as part of its campaign strategy.
 
 
 
• **Aam Aadmi Party (AAP):**
 
 
• AAP was the ruling party in Delhi prior to the 2025 elections, having won a landslide victory in 2020.
 
• The party’s focus areas included education, healthcare, and affordable electricity.
 
 
 
• **Voter Turnout:**
 
 
• The voter turnout in the 2025 Delhi Assembly elections was reported to be around **65%**, indicating active participation by the electorate.
 
• Women voters played a crucial role in influencing the election results.
